name: spotbugs
description: Static analysis tool for Java bytecode that finds bugs, security vulnerabilities, and code quality issues using over 400 detectors

spotbugs.description: Advanced Java bytecode analyzer that detects potential bugs, security vulnerabilities, performance issues and code quality problems
spotbugs.usage:
spotbugs analyze -textui -output results.xml MyProject.jar
spotbugs gui
spotbugs -textui -effort:max -priority:high MyProject.jar
spotbugs analyze -xml:withMessages -output report.xml MyProject.jar
spotbugs -textui -exclude filter.xml MyProject.jar
